description: Use when preparing for a model risk management examination, building an SR 26-2 compliant model governance program, or assessing a financial institution's MRM framework against regulatory expectations. Returns Federal Reserve SR 26-2 and OCC requirements across development, independent validation, ongoing monitoring, and governance — with exam deficiency rates showing where institutions most commonly fail. For AI and ML models, SR 26-2 explicitly requires independent validation even for vendor-supplied models and black-box systems. Example: Documentation deficiencies are the most common exam finding at 67% of reviewed institutions — inadequate conceptual soundness documentation for credit scoring models triggers immediate MRA (Matter Requiring Attention). Source: Federal Reserve SR 26-2, OCC Bulletin 2026-13, FDIC FIL-15-2026. $0.50 USDC per call.
